planted.heading: Parties
planted.note: The counterparty may substitute any group company as the contracting entity without telling us.

planted.heading: Indemnity
planted.note: We indemnify them for everything, without limit, even when the fault is theirs.

planted.heading: Governing Law
planted.note: Any dispute has to be arbitrated abroad, in a seat and language that suit only them.

planted.heading: General
planted.note: The counterparty can change the terms of the contract on its own by posting an update.
